description:
The clauses \(\{p,q\}\) and \(\{
eg p,
eg q\}\) resolve to \(\{q,
eg q\}\) on \(p\) and to \(\{p,
eg p\}\) on \(q\). Both parents are satisfied when \(p\) is true and \(q\) is false.
